pages.text: Untainted Immortal Body is now a physique, and Untainted Immortal Incantation is an immortal-tier element-less technique. Having both unlocks the full untainted immunity package: no potion effects, fire or burning, knockback, entanglement or slowing, plus darkvision without a potion effect.
Qingdi Longevity is an immortal Wood technique. It greatly boosts Wood spells, lowers their cost, and converts qi into healing: every 1 second, spend 50 qi to restore 5 health.
